**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 11.1(c)–(d), ¶p0559–p0560).**

- **What is fine (no redline):** Ono owns IP made solely by its personnel (11.1(a)); the Section 2.6 Grant-Back is a non-exclusive, worldwide, royalty-free licence limited to Products and subject to Ono's exclusive rights — not an assignment of Ono IP or Improvements; Data flows by exchange/right of reference (4.7–4.8) with Ono owning its INDs and Marketing Approvals (4.2(b)–(c)); Array assigns Product Trademarks to Ono (12.2), and the 12.6 domain-name transfer is limited to termination.
- **What fails the fallback:** joint ownership of jointly-created inventions is coupled with an internal-purposes-only limitation and a consent gate on licensing, enforcement and assignment — joint ownership without an unrestricted right to exploit, which is walk-away territory under the rule.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** replaces 11.1(d)'s first sentence so each Party may freely practise, exploit and license co-owned IP subject to the exclusive licences granted, retaining consent only for assignment of a co-ownership interest.
